arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Michael Carvin argued the threat creates a justiciable controversy.
He claimed waiting for prosecution forces speakers to admit guilt.
Michael Murphy argued the group failed to show a credible threat.
He stated the alleged injury is not certainly impending.
